cmd:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$bashFile = Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe' -ErrorAction Stop
& $bashFile.FullName -c 'git -c core.longpaths=true -c maintenance.auto=false diff --quiet && git -c core.longpaths=true -c maintenance.auto=false rev-parse HEAD'
exit $LASTEXITCODE
